summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords in the unpadded frame, including channel; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator with channel-prepended patch_size, ensure_tuple start_pos, NumpyPadMode mode; reworked GridPatchDataset taking dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; np.ceil worker split; per-patch apply_transform with map_items=False; PatchDataset docstring float fix; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds test_shape and test_loading_array. Choices: the missing-length NotImplementedError is raised at the start of __iter__, not in the constructor. Risks: tests were not run. The pinned four-decimal values in test_loading_array may exceed the 1e-5 relative tolerance by rounding. utils.py lines 232-234 (pre-existing get_valid_patch_size docstring) remain over 120 characters, left unchanged per the verbatim rule.
